peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 8.5% below its local comparables; 23 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (50.9): 3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 134 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,025,000 ($1,562 psf, 1,227–1,431 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,707 psf (range $1,507–1,775); 8.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $188,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Hillview MRT about 320 m, Cashew MRT about 590 m; closer than 395 of 462 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace about 250 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

nearest.name: CHIJ Our Lady Queen of Peace

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 320 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre about 1,590 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 70 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 420 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 760 m; The Myst, 46 new sales, about 980 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 1,020 m; The Arden, 3 new sales, about 1,710 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 60 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 278 new sales and 514 resales (792 purchases); new sales were 35.1% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 750 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 514 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 96 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 514 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 548 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.2%). Planning-area private resales −2.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
